notes: Upstream reads the permanent dataset gitstuff.class_birthdate via a hardcoded SAS Viya home libname, then doubles every row with two OUTPUT statements. The doubling DATA step (data/set/output;output;/run;) is verbatim from a program.sas. class_birthdate is sashelp.class (the 19 class records: Name/Sex/Age/Height/Weight) plus a Birthdate column, so the bundle seeds it from sashelp.class with a deterministic Birthdate derived from Age, keeping the script self-contained (Viya home path rewritten to a relative directory). A trailing PROC SQL count surfaces the doubling in the listing. Captured run: 19 rows seeded, doubling produces 38 rows (6 columns); listing shows 'Rows after doubling = 38'. Reproducible across POSTs; no vendor banner in log/listing.
